entries.label: 가공 공장
entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original location background for a Korean classic industrial management strategy game, landscape 8:5 composition, target 1600 by 1000 pixels, one full-bleed scene.
Art direction: This must belong to the same visual world as a meticulously detailed 1990s PC-98 strategy-game manager's office overlooking a coastal coil yard at sunrise. Sophisticated high-density pixel illustration: deliberate small square pixel clusters, crisp stepped contours, finely controlled dither in shadow planes, tiny hand-drawn industrial detail, convincing object proportions and materials. The picture remains richly legible when reduced to a 950-pixel-wide game viewport. Do not make huge blocky pixels or smear fine details. This is authored retro game environmental illustration, not a photograph, not smooth glossy 3D, not watercolor, not a cute miniature.
Palette: deep blue navy and dark teal shadows, desaturated sage green painted steel and roofs, warm beige concrete, cold silver-gray coils, restrained muted gold morning light. Full tonal depth with clear silhouettes and warm/cool separation. Architectural perspective from a moderately elevated three-quarter viewpoint, composed like a playable location rather than a distant world map.
Setting: a fictional modern overseas cold steel COIL SERVICE CENTER in the coastal industrial district of Novaria. Cold processing, storage and trade only.
Absolute constraints: no steelmaking furnaces, no smelting, no glowing hot metal, no molten metal, no refinery towers, no giant smokestacks. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signs with writing, labels, badges, interface controls, arrows, frames, captions or collage. No foreground people or portraits. No artificial blur, depth-of-field blur, lens bloom or glossy cinematic effects. Render as finished cohesive game artwork with a calm readable spatial hierarchy. The image itself contains only the environment.

Scene: the interior of a broad cold-coil processing hall seen from a visitor's slightly elevated walkway, looking diagonally across the production floor. The unmistakable hero is a coherent slitting and leveling line: a single large silver steel coil secured on an uncoiler feeds flat cold strip through a bank of practical green steel rollers; slit coils and neatly stacked cut sheets sit in distinct downstream storage areas. Include a credible overhead bridge crane on ceiling rails with a C-hook, steel roof trusses, an operator control station without text, tool cabinets, guarded machinery and clean pedestrian paths. Tall side windows admit warm morning shafts onto the cold metal and concrete, while the large hall retains richly patterned teal shadows. Close machinery gives tactile scale in the foreground, and a wide open roller-line area forms the readable middle of the composition. No office desk or conference room. A quiet industrial workplace, not a heroic steel foundry.

Scene: an organized steel-coil storage yard at the edge of the company's low-roof warehouse, seen diagonally from the warehouse entrance balcony. The unmistakable hero is several varied rows of cold silver-gray coils with visible circular hollow centers and fine layered edges, each secured in sturdy saddle cradles on concrete bays. Coil axes are horizontal; realistic heavy scale, not enormous architectural-size rolls. A gantry crane and C-hook serve the storage lanes; a small empty forklift and a loaded flatbed truck wait beside the covered loading bay. Include a sheltered warehouse interior at one edge and low processing sheds in the distance, with the sea and port cranes only a small atmospheric background. Warm low morning sun draws crisp long diagonal shadows between the cool silver coils. Clear practical transport aisles and subtle unlettered floor boundary lines make stock storage distinct from the factory processing scene. Nothing rusty or abandoned, no heaps of scrap. No office interior.

Scene: the import quay for cold steel coils, viewed from a moderately elevated dockside inspection platform. A substantial cargo ship moored alongside a concrete wharf dominates the middle distance, with an open cargo hold and a working dock gantry crane holding a properly rigged steel-coil cargo cradle. Foreground contains a few cold silver coils on secured saddles, some weather-protected wrapped bundles, dock bollards and heavy mooring ropes; a waiting flatbed and a low-roof bonded transit warehouse define the logistics route. Open water reflects a restrained gold early-morning sky; distant coastal hills and modest port cranes establish the same industrial district as the office. Crisp blue-teal water, graphite ship hull, sage warehouse roofs, warm beige quays, cold metallic coils. Strong readable ship/crane/coils silhouettes, plausible scale. Composition must feel like visiting a specific wharf, not an aerial map or a generic container terminal. No ship names or markings, no offshore refinery or steelmaking complex.

Scene: an industrial customer's meeting and sample-inspection area at an automotive parts factory. View diagonally into a practical, dignified customer consultation room, with a medium-sized rectangular worktable in the foreground displaying unlettered order sheets, a small brushed-metal coil sample, a caliper and neat flat sheet samples. Three or four visitor chairs and a modest sample rack with recognizable stamped automotive body panels and brackets establish commercial negotiations. The major visual anchor is a broad glass partition occupying the back of the scene: beyond it, a clean automotive sheet-metal stamping and assembly hall with presses, metal body panels on racks and a low-roof receiving bay. The customer processes supplied sheet into automotive parts; do not show the coil-center slitting line as the hero. Muted sage walls and steel window mullions, warm wood tabletop, deep teal shade and gold morning light across the sample pieces. It should feel like a distinct visit to a customer, and share the detailed old-PC strategy illustration language of the manager's office. No executive leather throne, trophies, company logos or legible documents.
